what_broke: Carta company_embeddings.json was empty (0 semantic units) — BFS crawl returned nothing
root_cause: Two issues: (1) BFS queue never seeded with base_url when no seed_urls provided — only sitemap/RSS pages were added but sitemaps returned 403. (2) carta.com is behind Cloudflare JS challenge — all httpx requests return 403 regardless of User-Agent.
fix_applied: (1) Always append base_url to priority_queue. (2) Added 3-tier fallback: httpx → Playwright headless Chromium → Wayback Machine. Site-level flag skips httpx after first CF detection.
lesson: Always seed BFS with base_url regardless of seed_urls. Major sites use Cloudflare — need headless browser fallback for reliable crawling.
recurrence_prevention: base_url is now always in priority_queue. Playwright fallback handles CF-protected sites automatically.

what_broke: Langfuse tracing errors: 'Langfuse' object has no attribute 'trace' — all tracing silently failed during live pipeline run
root_cause: tracing.py was written for Langfuse v2 API (lf.trace(), target.generation(), target.span()) but langfuse 3.14.1 was installed. v3 removed these methods entirely.
fix_applied: Rewrote tracing.py to use v3 SDK API: lf.trace() → lf.start_span() + span.update_trace(session_id=...), target.generation() → target.start_generation() + gen.end(), target.span() → target.start_span(), usage= → usage_details=, span.end(**kwargs) → span.update(**kwargs) then span.end().
lesson: Always verify SDK API against installed version, not docs that may describe a different version. Langfuse v3 is a breaking change from v2. Also note: start_generation is already deprecated in 3.14.1 in favor of start_observation(as_type='generation').
recurrence_prevention: v3 API is now used throughout. Monitor for start_observation migration when upgrading langfuse.
